assumptions.choice: Used bt.indicators.RateOfChange(close, period=252) to compute the 12-month rate of return as (close[0]-close[-252])/close[-252].
assumptions.reason: Spec names 'Rate of Return' over 12 months / 252 trading days; RateOfChange implements this exact fractional-return formula, and using a built-in indicator gives automatic minperiod warm-up handling per the canonical default.

assumptions.choice: Computed size = broker.getcash() / data.close[0] at the moment of each new entry (long or short) instead of using the default plain-size buy()/sell().
assumptions.reason: The spec explicitly states position size is fixed at 100% of available capital, which overrides canonical default #1 (that default only applies when sizing is unstated).

assumptions.choice: On a trend flip while in a position, only self.close() is issued that cycle; the opposite entry is issued once the strategy is flat (next order-tracking cycle) rather than submitting a simultaneous close+reverse order.
assumptions.reason: The spec lists Exit and Entry as separate rule sets and canonical default #5 requires guarding against overlapping pending orders, so the position naturally reverses over consecutive bars rather than a single same-bar flip order.

assumptions.choice: When the 252-day return is exactly 0, no entry or exit action is taken; existing position (if any) is held.
assumptions.reason: Spec conditions are strictly 'above zero' / 'below zero', leaving the exact-zero case undefined; holding the current state is the most literal reading.

assumptions.choice: No commission override attempted; the strategy trades as specified and lets the harness-configured 0.001 commission apply.
assumptions.reason: infeasible — the spec states commissions/slippage are not considered, but the execution environment fixes commission at 0.001 via harness-managed Cerebro/broker setup that the strategy class does not control.
